title: 2021 Fall AMC 10A Problem 7
statement: As shown in the figure below, point \(E\) lies in the opposite half-plane determined by line \(CD\) from point \(A\) so that \(\angle CDE = 110^\circ.\) Point \(F\) lies on \(\overline{AD}\) so that \(DE=DF,\) and \(ABCD\) is a square. What is the degree measure of \(\angle AFE?\)

solutions.text:
Since \(\angle ADC = 90^{\circ},\) we get that \[ \angle FDE = 360^{\circ} - 90^{\circ} - 110^{\circ} \]\[= 160^{\circ}. \] Also since \(\triangle FDE\) is isosceles, we get that \[ \angle EFD = \dfrac{180^{\circ} - 160^{\circ}}{2} = 10^{\circ}. \] Finally, we get that \[ \angle AFE = 180^{\circ} - 10^{\circ} = 170^{\circ}. \]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Find the large angle \(\angle FDE\) around point \(D\)
